note: Management controls (docs/05 §7.3, docs/06). Human-edited; every change must be its own commit — the commit IS the audit event. kill=true blocks every order and freezes cycles. pause_entries=true blocks new buys; exits still flow. excluded_symbols blocks buys of a name and, if it is held, sells it in full at the next open (a forced exit); sales are never blocked. gross_cap (0..1) caps gross exposure: a breach holds the night for a human. Schema v2 (docs/08 §7.2, live/controls_schema.py): locked_symbols — the agent may neither buy nor sell a name; manual_orders — the console's manual sells (and buys only when allow_manual_buys=true), each with an id, reason and expiry session; pause_adapt — freezes adapt() from pause_adapt_since. Missing keys mean off.
